publication_scope: Verified dataset only, not manuscript or author approval

matrix_experiment.scope: Independent finite matrices, not self-consistent CP2K

electronic_structure_calculations.scope: Matched compact solver tests, not converged materials predictions

limitations: Full-AO Ni and several denser-mesh or constrained cases exhaust their numerical budgets
Tight finite-temperature dynamics does not complete for every minimizer
Occupation-preconditioner OFF can report SCF convergence at an inequivalent endpoint
Only wavefunctions, not complete minimizer histories, are restarted
Compact models do not establish materials accuracy, general speedup, or long-time stability
